topic: Day 90 — reel — Identity is a rolling average of your last hundred decisions
text:
Identity
is a rolling
[average], not
a fixed trait.
caption:
It feels permanent because it only moves in increments you can't see. New choices genuinely change who you are, not just how you look.

Follow for one of these a day.
